title.rendered: One dead, three injured as building collapses in Kano

content.rendered:
At least one person has been confirmed dead after a two-storey building under construction collapsed on Sultan Road in Kano metropolis on Friday.

The Public Relations Officer of the Kano State Fire Service, Saminu Abdullahi, confirmed the incident in a telephone interview with The PUNCH on Friday.

According to him, the incident occurred around 9 a.m. while the victims were working on the building.

“As a result of the collapse of the building, one person lost his life while three others sustained varying degrees of injuries,” Abdullahi said.

He said three victims were initially rescued from the rubble, while emergency responders made efforts to reach the fourth person trapped beneath the debris. The victim was, however, later found dead.

Eyewitnesses said workers noticed signs that the building was about to collapse while they were working on the upper floor and immediately fled the site.

“The engineer noticed signs that the building was about to collapse, so the workers immediately ran for safety,” a witness who identified himself simply as Yaro said.

He added, “Three victims, including the security guard and one of my friends, were rescued and taken to Sir Muhammadu Sanusi Specialist Hospital for treatment after sustaining injuries.”
